scripts.dev: npm run build && concurrently -n "api,web" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w @penga/api" "npm run dev -w @penga/web"
scripts.dev:all: npm run build && concurrently -n "shared,api,web" -c "yellow,blue,green" "npm run dev -w @penga/shared" "npm run dev -w @penga/api" "npm run dev -w @penga/web"
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run --workspaces --if-present test
